# 05 `linkStyle` styles an edge, addressed by index

## Outcome

`linkStyle 0 stroke:#f00` styles the first declared edge. `linkStyle 0,2 ...` styles several, and
`linkStyle default ...` styles every edge the document did not name specifically.

## Why this ticket exists

Edges are the half of a flowchart that `style` cannot reach — Mermaid gives them their own
directive, addressed differently, and an author who can color a box but not the arrow between two
boxes will notice immediately.

**The index is an authored spelling, not a vocabulary.** This is the ticket where the board's one
genuine conflict gets resolved, and the resolution is board 1's: the author writes `linkStyle 0`
because that is what Mermaid documents, and the model resolves 0 to the edge id `A-B` that
`timeline:` and `data-siren-id` already use. An index must not survive into the layout or the
renderer — if one does, an edge has two names downstream and the next board pays for it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `linkStyle <n> <prop>:<value>,...` styles the edge declared `n`th, zero-based, in document
      order. Assert against a document with at least three edges, so an off-by-one fails.
- [x] `linkStyle 0,2 ...` applies to each listed index. A malformed index in the list is an error
      diagnostic that costs itself, leaving the others applied.
- [x] `linkStyle default ...` applies to every edge. A specific `linkStyle N` on an edge overrides
      the default for that edge, per ADR-0008's last-declaration-wins rule — assert the
      interaction, in both source orders.
- [x] An index with no edge (`linkStyle 9` in a two-edge document) is an error diagnostic naming
      the index and how many edges exist.
- [x] **No index reaches beyond `buildFlowchartModel`.** `GraphEdge`/`PositionedEdge` carry
      resolved properties keyed by nothing but the edge itself, and the renderer never sees a
      number. Assert this at the model seam, not only through the SVG.
- [x] The declarations reach the `<path class="siren-edge">` as an inline `style` attribute. Check
      where the theme styles an edge before choosing the element — the arrowhead lives in
      `<defs><marker>` and is styled separately, so say in your report whether `stroke` on an edge
      recolors its arrowhead, and assert whichever is true rather than changing the renderer.
- [x] The shared gate applies: `linkStyle 0 stroke:url(#evil)` is rejected with the same message.
- [x] A styled edge still animates — `linkStyle` and a `timeline:` entry on the same edge coexist.

## Test seam

`parseFlowchart` through the source string; `buildFlowchartModel` for index-to-id resolution, which
is the part with no SVG evidence; `render()` for what lands.
